value.name: Campus value model
value.about: Points above a replacement-level player: EPA on the player's plays for skill players, box-score points for defenders and specialists.

epa.name: Opponent-adjusted EPA
epa.about: Expected points added per play at the player's position, garbage time excluded; team EPA rates adjusted for the opponents faced.

box.name: Box rating
box.about: Points per 100 possessions above an average D-I player: our team-constrained box value, so a player on a strong team against a strong schedule is credited for it.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: Our opponent-adjusted team rating, split into offence and defence.

value_pg: Points above a replacement-level player per game: EPA on the player's plays for skill players, box-score points for defenders and specialists (value.json).
epa_play: Expected points added per credited play at the player's position (QB: dropbacks and runs; RB: carries and targets; WR/TE: targets and carries), garbage time excluded.
sr_db: Share of dropbacks that gain expected points (a steadier read than yards).
int_rate: Interceptions per pass attempt; noisy from one season to the next.
rush_pg: Designed runs and scrambles per game: how much the quarterback carries the ball (style).
epa_db: Expected points added per dropback, sacks and interceptions included.
sack_rate: Sacks per dropback: the most quarterback-driven part of protection.
ypd: Yards per dropback after sack losses.
qb_rush_epa: Expected points added per quarterback run.
db: Dropbacks credited from the play-by-play (the volume behind the rates).
value: Season total of points above a replacement-level player.
epa: Total expected points added on credited plays.
sr_rush: Share of carries that gain expected points.
rush_share: Share of the team's carries in the games played: the role in the run game.
tgt_share: Share of the team's targets that went to the player in the games played: how often the player earns the ball.
stuff_rate: Share of carries stopped for no gain or a loss.
yptpa: Receiving yards per team pass attempt in the games played: a route-free stand-in for yards per route run.
sr_tgt: Share of targets to the player that gain expected points.
havoc_pg: Tackles for loss, passes defended, interceptions and QB hurries per game: disruptive plays.
hurries_pg: Quarterback hurries per game (ESPN's box count).
tkl_pg: Solo and assisted tackles per game (involvement and range).
pd_pg: Passes broken up or intercepted per game: the coverage credit in the box score.
tfl_pg: Tackles behind the line per game (sacks included).
def_int_pg: Interceptions per game. Mostly luck from one season to the next.
fg_pct: Field goals made per attempt (no kick distances in the box score).
fga_pg: Field-goal attempts per game (how much the coach uses the kicker).
fg_long: Longest made field goal of the season.
gross: Average punt distance: the steadiest punting number.
in20_rate: Share of punts downed inside the 20.
r: Points per 100 possessions above an average D-I player: the site's team-constrained box value, so a player on a strong team against a strong schedule is credited for it.
pts100: Points scored per 100 team possessions while on the floor.
ts_add: Points per 100 possessions gained by shooting above the D-I true-shooting rate on the player's volume.
ast_pct: Share of team-mates' baskets assisted while on the floor.
fta100: Free-throw attempts per 100 possessions: pressure on the rim and fouls drawn.
stl_pct: Steals per opponent possession while on the floor.
trb_pct: Share of all available rebounds grabbed while on the floor.
ts: Points per shooting attempt, counting threes and free throws.
efg: Field-goal percentage with a three worth 1.5 makes.
tp_pct: Three-point percentage (needs a large sample: about 1,300-1,900 minutes to be half signal).
ft_pct: Free-throw percentage; also a good sign of shooting touch.
ortg: Points per 100 possessions the player uses.
usg: Share of team possessions the player uses on the floor (shots, free throws, turnovers).
tpar: Share of the player's shots from three (style, not quality).
orb_pct: Share of available offensive rebounds grabbed while on the floor.
drb_pct: Share of available defensive rebounds grabbed while on the floor.
blk_pct: Share of opponent two-point attempts blocked while on the floor.
pts: Points per game (minutes included: a leaderboard number).

rating: Expected margin against an average team on a neutral field (CFB: points per game; basketball: points per 100 possessions, adjusted efficiency margin).
off: Offensive points per game added against average (CFB) / adjusted points scored per 100 possessions (basketball).
def: Points per game prevented against average (CFB, higher is better) / adjusted points allowed per 100 possessions (basketball, lower is better).
epa_off: Opponent-adjusted expected points added per offensive play, garbage time excluded.
epa_def: Opponent-adjusted expected points allowed per play.
sr_off: Opponent-adjusted share of plays that gain expected points.
sr_def: Opponent-adjusted share of opponent plays that gain expected points.
pass_epa: Raw expected points added per dropback (not opponent-adjusted).
rush_epa: Raw expected points added per rush (not opponent-adjusted).
explosive: Rushes of 15+ and passes of 20+ yards per play.
to_margin: Takeaways minus giveaways per game: mostly luck from one season to the next.
sos: Mean rating of opponents played (context, not quality). Shown without a better/worse colour.
tempo: Adjusted possessions per 40 minutes (style: no better direction). Shown without a better/worse colour.
efg: Shooting, with a three worth 1.5 makes (four factors: shooting).
tov_rate: Turnovers per possession (four factors: ball security).
orb_rate: Share of its own misses the team rebounds (four factors: second chances).
ftr: Free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt (four factors: getting to the line).
drb_rate: Share of opponents' misses the team rebounds.
opp_ftr: Opponents' free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt.
luck: Wins above what the margins imply, per game: does not repeat.
tpar: Share of shots from three (style). Shown without a better/worse colour.
